snippet.title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! | Partnership Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Prep your stations for a management-sim cooking game with attitude! Utilize long-honed recipes as you prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant!
